title: Gold Elvis Wedding or Vow Renewal at Las Vegas Sign
blurb:
Experience the ultimate Las Vegas tradition with a fun, heartfelt Elvis wedding or vow renewal at the world-famous Welcome to Fabulous Las Vegas sign. Performed by a professional Elvis officiant, your ceremony includes live singing, romantic vows, and a memorable first dance in one of the most iconic locations in the world.

Unlike many traditional chapels, you’re free to take unlimited photos and record the entire ceremony with your own phone—we even provide a phone holder to make it easy. Optional upgrades available that include a professional photographer with 20+ or 100+ photos, so you can capture every moment your way.

This is a flexible, stress-free way to celebrate your love in true Vegas style!
